profile_definition: Under a preconfigured policy, both terminals know the MCS and profile directory; the 12-bit profile identifies the endpoint within that directory.
current_directory_semantics: A public method/MCS directory is shared protocol context, fixed before calibration; a current data frame signals the endpoint or paid NULL only. No per-frame MCS/directory negotiation is claimed.
historical_directory_semantics: Older joint catalogues included MCS in each entry; catalogue identity was still preconfigured. Separate IDs and hash pins are indexed in S1.3.

main_timing.policy: H10; earlier N1024/10-dB policy; not a new U-policy timing run
main_timing.device: one RTX PRO 6000 and two distinct physical CPU cores
main_timing.boundaries: canonical RGB to actual symbols; received symbols to RGB

compiled_Ada: Separate implementation and corresponding 32-source diagnostic; no substitution into common500 quality or claimed matched NeST/Ada speedup.
